question.from: Which of the following statements about functions is false?
question.to: In which quadrant of the coordinate plane would an angle with measure 982º lie?

w.from: An even function is such that f(x) = f(-x)

x.from: Even functions cannot have more than one x intercept

y.from: Odd functions are such that f(x) = -f(-x)

z.from: Odd functions must pass through more than one quadrant of the coordinate plane

answer.from: X) EVEN FUNCTIONS CANNOT HAVE MORE THAN ONE X-INTERCEPT
